annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision (EU) 2018/1617 of 25 October 2018 concerning a measure adopted by France pursuant to Council Directive 93/42/EEC with regard to the Terrafor and Defiligne medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision (EU) 2018/1617 of 25 October 2018 concerning a measure adopted by France pursuant to Council Directive 93/42/EEC with regard to the Terrafor and Defiligne medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 270/29
annotation.summary_en: Commission Decision under the safeguard clause of Directive 93/42/EEC finding justified France's suspension and withdrawal of the lead-containing oral capsules Terrafor and Defiligne. It is unrelated to AI or robotics; it concerns medical device risk/benefit, clinical evaluation and incorrect application of harmonised standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: France's 16 August 2016 measure suspending and withdrawing Terrafor and Defiligne is justified
Lead content exceeded the ICH Q3D 5 µg/day threshold, so the risk/benefit ratio was unfavourable
Manufacturer failed to minimise risk and to provide clinical data for the claimed benefits
Harmonised ISO 10993 standards were incorrectly applied, so no presumption of conformity
Decision is addressed to the Member States
